summary: HeyGen Voice Turbo is a lower-latency version of HeyGen Voice, HeyGen's text-to-speech model. OpenRouter serves a free variant, heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo:free, that takes text and returns speech at $0. It has 10 default voices (nadine, tabitha, bram, gareth, noelle, meredith, sabrina, lucian, weston, vincent). Users can bring their own HeyGen key to use voice clones.
claim_steps: Create an OpenRouter account and API key
Call model heygen/heygen-voice-1-turbo:free through the OpenRouter API with text input and a voice
